title: HtmlDialog
responsibility: Renders the native dialog element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlDialog.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet rendered inside the native dialog when provided; it is invoked only when truthy. When omitted, it is undefined and no child content is rendered.

outputs.name: HtmlDialog
outputs.description: The rendered output is the native dialog element, with all remaining props spread onto it. If children is truthy, its snippet is rendered inside; the component adds no wrapper or other behavior.
